facts.fact: UNCDF's assessment says citizens open bank and mobile money accounts by presenting national IDs, but Burundi has no national identity database to support financial institutions in KYC checks, so account-opening KYC is not checked against an ID register.
facts.system: Bank and mobile money account-opening KYC
